## Soft-fails / out-of-band

- `next dev` hydration failure in this sandbox — `next dev` (Turbopack) served the `/login` and `/register` pages, but client components never hydrated (no React fiber attached, HMR websocket handshake failed with `ERR_INVALID_HTTP_RESPONSE`, forms fell through to native GET submission). Worked around by running the ephemeral web service in production mode (`next build && next start`), matching the project's own `apps/web/playwright.config.ts` `webServer` strategy for its E2E gate. This is an environment/tooling quirk of this sandbox, not a contract failure — all UI/E2E items subsequently passed cleanly against the production build. Worth a note in `apps/web/CLAUDE.md`/`AGENTS.md` if `next dev` is expected to work here for manual QA.
